reader_sentence: On all three models (GPT-2 small, Pythia-410M, Gemma-2-2B), integrated gradients agreed with ablation the most (Spearman ρ ≈ 0.80–0.89, with confidence intervals that don't overlap the other methods), followed in order by attribution patching (~0.6), gradient times input (~0.45), saliency (~0.3), and activation magnitude (~0.15–0.19).
intended: Integrated gradients matches ablation best on all three models (rank correlation about 0.8 to 0.9), clearly ahead of the next best method, attribution patching (about 0.6).
